column1: # BIOS files RetroArch cores look for, relative to the BIOS directory
# (/storage/bios on the ROMS partition, /games/bios on a second card).
#   required  without the dump the core stops with a black screen
#   hle       the core has a high-level emulation fallback, the game starts but
#             some features (memory cards, CD audio seek, firmware menu) differ
#   optional  region variant or extra file, one of the listed files is enough
# These are firmware dumps that cannot be shipped with DEEPoS: put your own
# copies in place (see docs/BIOS.md). Open replacements that ARE shipped:
# EmuTOS for Atari ST (tos.img) and C-BIOS for MSX (Machines/MSX*).
